learning_outcomes.text: The student can explain the opportunities and challenges of AI in the different applications seen.
The student assesses the relevance of these techniques for specific applications, and can give appropriate advice on the feasibility and complexity of the AI solution.
The student can analyze and correctly use a given dataset for an AI system.
The student can build a working AI solution given a problem statement. The student takes into account good actual performance, ethical and practical considerations.
The student can explain this AI solution and justify the choices made.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to common AI applications such as computer vision, NLP, health, Industry, Consultancy, MLOps, time-series forecasting, insurance & finance
Project: The student develops a given AI project

assessment_methods.method: Written exam during the examination period

assessment_rules: The evaluation consists of two parts: 50% written exam and 50% project. Within this course, AI-specific concepts of the project (dataset use, overfitting, prediction result, etc.) are evaluated. Python code is evaluated via the Python for AI course. For resits, the same modalities apply as in the first examination period, and there are no partial transfers.
bibliography: Slides and online material, provided via Canvas.
